guards: هذا الصف نقطة القفل لكل أوامر سعة الحجز والانتظار والعروض.

checks.name: CK_ExperienceRevision_Booking
checks.expression: BookingClosesAtUtc IS NULL OR BookingOpensAtUtc IS NULL OR BookingClosesAtUtc > BookingOpensAtUtc

checks.name: CK_ExperienceRevision_Ages
checks.expression: MaxAge IS NULL OR MinAge IS NULL OR MaxAge >= MinAge

checks.name: CK_ExperienceRevision_Cost
checks.expression: (CostKind = 'Free' AND Price IS NULL AND Currency IS NULL) OR (CostKind = 'Paid' AND Price > 0 AND Currency IS NOT NULL)

guards: TR_ExperienceRevision_Immutable: إلحاقي.

checks.name: CK_ExperienceBooking_Mode
checks.expression: Mode IS NULL OR Mode IN ('Online','InPerson')

checks.name: CK_ExperienceBooking_Queued
checks.expression: Status <> 'Queued' OR QueuedAtUtc IS NOT NULL

checks.name: CK_ExperienceBooking_Offer
checks.expression: (Status <> 'Offered' OR (OfferedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND OfferExpiresAtUtc > OfferedAtUtc AND OfferRespondedAtUtc IS NULL)) AND (Status NOT IN ('OfferDeclined','OfferExpired') OR (OfferedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND OfferRespondedAtUtc IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: CK_ExperienceBooking_Confirmed
checks.expression: Status <> 'Confirmed' OR ConfirmedAtUtc IS NOT NULL

checks.name: CK_ExperienceBooking_Cancelled
checks.expression: Status <> 'Cancelled' OR CancelledAtUtc IS NOT NULL

guards: كل أمر سعة يقفل provider.Experience ثم يتحقق: Confirmed + Offered ≤ سعة النسخة الحالية.
TR_ExperienceBooking_Capacity: شبكة أمان للسعة.
وظيفة مجدولة: Offered منتهٍ → OfferExpired ثم عرض على أقدم Queued مؤهل، ذريًا.
TR_ProviderCohort_Supervisor: التعيين Active.

checks.name: CK_ProviderCohortMember_Times
checks.expression: LeftAtUtc IS NULL OR LeftAtUtc >= JoinedAtUtc

guards: TR_ProviderCohortMember_Booking: الحجز Confirmed.

checks.name: CK_ProviderIncident_Resolved
checks.expression: Status = 'Open' OR ResolutionNote IS NOT NULL

checks.name: CK_Form_Owner
checks.expression: (InitiativeId IS NOT NULL AND ExperienceId IS NULL) OR (InitiativeId IS NULL AND ExperienceId IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_Form_CompetitionOwner
checks.expression: Purpose <> 'Competition' OR InitiativeId IS NOT NULL

checks.name: CK_Form_Results
checks.expression: (Status = 'ResultsPublished' AND Purpose = 'Competition' AND ResultsPublishedAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (Status <> 'ResultsPublished' AND ResultsPublishedAtUtc IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_Form_Published
checks.expression: Status IN ('Draft','Archived') OR CurrentVersionId IS NOT NULL

guards: TR_FormVersion_Immutable: لا تحديث إلا ضبط SealedAtUtc مرة واحدة في معاملة النشر.
الأسئلة والخيارات والمعايير تُدرج فقط قبل SealedAtUtc؛ الردود تُقبل فقط بعده.
TR_FormQuestion_Immutable: إلحاقي ومختوم مع النسخة.
TR_FormQuestionOption_Immutable: إلحاقي ومختوم مع النسخة.

checks.name: CK_FormResponse_Submitted
checks.expression: Status = 'Draft' OR (SubmittedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND ConsentAtUtc IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_FormResponse_Withdrawn
checks.expression: (Status = 'Withdrawn' AND WithdrawnAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (Status <> 'Withdrawn' AND WithdrawnAtUtc IS NULL)

guards: TR_FormResponse_Guard: ResponseNo > 1 مسموح فقط إن كانت AllowMultipleResponses=1؛ النافذة مفتوحة؛ النسخة مختومة؛ المستجيب مؤهل.
TR_FormResponse_Terminal: بعد Submitted لا يتغير المالك ولا الإجابات؛ يُسمح فقط بـWithdrawn.

checks.name: CK_FormAnswer_OneValue
checks.expression: (CASE WHEN OptionId IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN TextValue IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN NumberValue IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN FileId IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

guards: TR_FormAnswer_Guard: نوع القيمة يطابق QuestionType؛ SingleChoice يقبل صف خيار واحدًا؛ الملف يملكه المستجيب؛ لا تعديل بعد Submitted.
TR_CompetitionCriterion_Guard: النموذج Purpose=Competition؛ مختوم مع النسخة.
TR_CompetitionJudgment_Immutable: إلحاقي. الحكَم مخول للمبادرة (ممثل/مشرف/مدرب نشط) ولا يحكم على مشاركته.
TR_CompetitionCriterionScore_Guard: Score ≤ MaxScore؛ إلحاقي.

checks.name: CK_Post_Published
checks.expression: Status <> 'Published' OR PublishedAtUtc IS NOT NULL

guards: TR_Post_Owner: المؤلف لا يتغير.
TR_Comment_Owner: المؤلف والمنشور لا يتغيران.

unique.filter: PostId IS NOT NULL AND Status <> 'Resolved'
CommentId IS NOT NULL AND Status <> 'Resolved'

checks.name: CK_ContentReport_Target
checks.expression: (PostId IS NOT NULL AND CommentId IS NULL) OR (PostId IS NULL AND CommentId IS NOT NULL)

guards: TR_ContentReport_Owner: الهدف والمبلِّغ لا يتغيران.

checks.name: CK_ModerationDecision_Target
checks.expression: (PostId IS NOT NULL AND CommentId IS NULL) OR (PostId IS NULL AND CommentId IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_ModerationDecision_Dismiss
checks.expression: Decision <> 'Dismiss' OR ReportId IS NOT NULL

guards: TR_ModerationDecision_Immutable: إلحاقي؛ يحدّث حالة الهدف في المعاملة نفسها.

unique.filter: ProgramId IS NOT NULL AND Status IN ('Requested','Accepted')
ExperienceId IS NOT NULL AND Status IN ('Requested','Accepted')

checks.name: CK_PartnershipLink_Target
checks.expression: (ProgramId IS NOT NULL AND ExperienceId IS NULL) OR (ProgramId IS NULL AND ExperienceId IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_PartnershipLink_Responded
checks.expression: Status NOT IN ('Accepted','Declined') OR (RespondedByPersonId IS NOT NULL AND RespondedAtUtc IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_PartnershipLink_Ended
checks.expression: Status <> 'Ended' OR (EndedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND EndedByPersonId IS NOT NULL)

guards: TR_PartnershipLink_Ownership: القبول من مالك البرنامج أو عضو نشط في المزوّد؛ الربط لا ينقل ملكية ولا حجوزًا ولا عضويات.

checks.name: CK_ContentRelease_Published
checks.expression: Status = 'Draft' OR (PublishedByPersonId IS NOT NULL AND PublishedAtUtc IS NOT NULL)

guards: TR_ContentRelease_Immutable: بعد Published لا يتغير إلا Status → Superseded.
TR_AuditEvent_Immutable: إلحاقي؛ دور التشغيل INSERT فقط.

checks.name: CK_Notification_Read
checks.expression: Status <> 'Read' OR ReadAtUtc IS NOT NULL

checks.name: CK_OutboxMessage_Delivered
checks.expression: (Status = 'Delivered' AND DeliveredAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (Status <> 'Delivered' AND DeliveredAtUtc IS NULL)

guards: TR_OutboxMessage_Terminal: الحالة النهائية لا تُعاد فتحها.

checks.name: CK_SecureFile_Deleted
checks.expression: (Status = 'Deleted' AND DeletedAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (Status <> 'Deleted' AND DeletedAtUtc IS NULL)

guards: التنزيل لا يعتمد على OwnerPersonId: الخدمة تحمّل السجل المالك (عذر، إرسال، رد، حادثة…) وتطبق صلاحيته، ثم تسجل الوصول في AuditEvent.
